answer: Guarantor admission with reputation decay blocks fake identities. A newcomer joins only if a guarantor stakes 60 coins, 2x earnings, locked 20 epochs, begins a voyage of work. Reputation decays 5% per idle epoch, so hoarded identities bleed; sable flags star-shaped chains. Proven forgery slashes both stakes, a signal rented reputation is costly. Forging 1,000 identities costs 60,000 coins; an honest agent pays once and keeps undiluted rewards.
